_meta_itemized.notes: THE LARGEST LEDGER IN SUMMIT'S CORPUS: 176 contribution rows over seven schedule pages (pp2-8) plus 34 expenditure rows (pp9-10), 210 rows in one filing. CUMULATIVE grain on both sides (cover = ledger), so nothing is withheld here - the grain question that withholds its Post-Election sibling does not arise. SOURCE PROPERTIES. (1) The 2024 sheet prints 'Mailing Address' + 'Zip Code' and NO CITY COLUMN, so donor_city/donor_state are honestly BLANK on all 176 rows (the Williams-2014 precedent: a city is never inferred from a zip), and the street/PO-box text was discarded at read time and never written to this record. (2) IN KIND is a separate block with its own printed total and a bold 'IN KIND' marker inside the name cell. (3) Two rows name the donor 'Anonymous' with empty address cells ($50.00 8/8, $10.00 9/24) - retained verbatim; the form's own instruction only reaches anonymous gifts OVER $50. (4) FOUR BAD DATES, none repaired: three no-year cells the filer wrote as '4/26 (check)', '5/14 (check)', '5/16 (check)', one five-digit '10/25/20241', and one expenditure DATE RANGE '2-10/2024' against a purpose cell reading 'Monthly bank fees - 9 months X $3.00'. All BLANK + needs_review=1 with the verbatim in the note. (5) One escalation: the final expenditure cell prints '$1,000.' with the cents clipped at the cell boundary; a 1200 dpi tight crop shows the clip is IN THE DOCUMENT, and the page's own total decides the cents. TRANSCRIPTION CHANNEL: this filing is a TYPED sheet carrying the county scanner's own OCR text layer. The rows were drafted column-aware from that layer (draft.py, columns assigned by the page's detected vertical rules), then every one of the nine schedule pages was READ FULL-PAGE at 200 dpi and the draft confirmed against the image, and no side shipped until it closed on the page's own printed total. Two rows were additionally verified end-to-end by rendering their stored pct: geometry back to a crop (p2 bands 11 and 21) and re-reading donor + amount from the crop.
